For Mumbai–Singapore return, I’d shortlist these fare types. Prices fluctuate, so treat them as indicative.

Option	Indicative return	Checked bag	Date flexibility
IndiGo Flexi Plus	~₹13,050+	30 kg	Change from ~₹299
Air India Flex	~₹20,000–30,000+	35 kg	Rescheduling at lower/no fee depending fare
Singapore Airlines Flexi	~₹25,000+	30 kg	Complimentary changes

What differentiates them:

IndiGo: lowest-cost flexible option; current MMT listings show Flexi Plus with 30 kg baggage. 
MakeMyTrip

Air India: generous 35 kg on Flex Economy; useful if carrying more luggage. 
Air India
+1

Singapore Airlines: strongest flexibility; Flexi allows complimentary changes and includes 30 kg. 
agent360.singaporeair.com

Check the exact change fee, fare difference, refundability and baggage allowance before payment.
